title: Coleus Kong Rose - 1x Mini Plug Plant - Easy Care Houseplant Unusual Variety
description:
Kong Rose Coleus is a vibrant foliage plant from the 'Kong' series, known for its huge, colourful leaves featuring a bright pink/rose centre with deep red veins, surrounded by a contrasting green border, perfect for adding drama to pots, baskets, or shady garden spots as a summer annual or houseplant. It's easy to grow, enjoys moist soil, and thrives in partial shade, offering stunning colour and a bushy habit.


Key Features



Large Leaves: Part of the 'Kong' series, meaning it has exceptionally big, showy foliage.


Colouration: Pink centre, dark red veining, and green edges.


Growth Habit: Bushy, reaching heights of 45-55cm (18-22 inches).


Versatile: Great for containers, hanging baskets, bedding, or as a houseplant.


Light: Prefers partial shade but can tolerate sun.



Growing Tips



Soil: Needs rich, well-draining soil with plenty of compost.


Watering: Keep soil consistently moist but not soggy; they are thirsty plants.


Maintenance: Pinch back regularly to encourage bushier growth and prevent flowering.


Propagation: Easy to propagate from stem cuttings.



Where to Use It



Shade Gardens: Adds bold colour where other plants struggle.


Patios & Balconies: Stunning in pots and hanging baskets.


Indoors: A beautiful houseplant during colder months
